summary: United States Brent Oil Fund, LP filed an 8-K after The Marygold Companies (TMC) announced a definitive agreement with Madison Dearborn Partners for TMC to go private in an all-cash transaction. TMC owns USCF Investments, the sole member of the fund's general partner. The deal is expected to close in H1 2027 or earlier, subject to TMC stockholder approval, regulatory approvals, and change-of-control consents. TMC shares will delist from NYSE. The filing states no per-share price. Watch regulatory and change-of-control approvals, plus the sponsor-level management transition risk.
